subject: ss-medical-oncology
title: Cutaneous and uveal melanoma: molecular drivers, targeted therapies and dual immunotherapy

steps.tx: Constitutive activation of the mitogen-activated protein kinase signaling cascade drives the development of skin melanoma. Activating **BRAF V600 mutations**, particularly V600E and V600K substitutions at codon 600, occur in approximately 40% to 50% of **cutaneous melanomas**. Rapid automated molecular genotyping determines treatment eligibility for small-molecule targeted therapies versus immune checkpoint inhibitors.

steps.tx: Dual targeted therapy combining **BRAF and MEK inhibitors** prevents paradoxical MAPK pathway reactivation and delays acquired resistance. Approved combinations like **dabrafenib** plus **trametinib** or **encorafenib** plus **binimetinib** yield rapid **objective response rates** exceeding 65% in BRAF V600-mutant melanoma. Targeted combinations achieve prompt symptomatic relief in patients presenting with high disease burden or visceral symptoms.

Approved combinations like dabrafenib plus trametinib or encorafenib plus binimetinib yield rapid objective response rates exceeding 65% in BRAF-mutant melanoma. steps.tx: Dual immune checkpoint inhibition established unprecedented long-term survival plateaus in the landmark **CheckMate 067** trial. Combining the PD-1 inhibitor **nivolumab** with the CTLA-4 inhibitor **ipilimumab** achieved durable 5-year overall survival exceeding 50% in previously untreated **advanced melanoma**. This durable plateau persisted regardless of baseline BRAF mutation status, though high rates of immune-related toxicities require proactive recognition and corticosteroid management.

left.title: Nivolumab + Ipilimumab
points: Higher rate of grade 3-4 immune toxicities

steps.tx: Targeting alternative lymphocyte inhibitory receptors provides another milestone in immuno-oncology. In the phase 3 **RELATIVITY-047** trial, combining **nivolumab** with the novel anti-LAG-3 monoclonal antibody **relatlimab** significantly prolonged progression-free survival compared to nivolumab monotherapy in untreated metastatic melanoma. Dual blockade of PD-1 and LAG-3 reactivates exhausted effector T-cells while exhibiting a favourable toxicity profile compared to ipilimumab combinations.

steps.tx: In resected high-risk melanoma, **Adjuvant anti-PD-1** monotherapy significantly reduces distant metastases and prolongs **recurrence-free survival**. One year of adjuvant **pembrolizumab** or **nivolumab** is established standard therapy for completely resected stage 2B, 2C, and stage 3 disease based on KEYNOTE-054, KEYNOTE-716, and CheckMate 238. For resected stage 3 BRAF-mutant melanoma, 12 months of adjuvant dabrafenib plus trametinib represents an effective oral alternative.

steps.tx: Neoadjuvant systemic therapy optimizes anti-tumour immune priming prior to definitive surgical excision. In the phase 3 **NADINA trial**, **Neoadjuvant dual immunotherapy** with two cycles of **ipilimumab** plus **nivolumab** induced high pathological complete response rates in macroscopic stage 3 nodal disease. Patients achieving a complete pathological response experienced exceptional event-free survival, allowing safe omission of planned adjuvant systemic therapies.

steps.tx: Primary intraocular uveal melanoma is biologically distinct from cutaneous disease, driven by GNAQ and GNA11 mutations. **Tebentafusp** is a first-in-class bispecific gp100 peptide-HLA-A*02:01-directed T-cell receptor therapeutic. In a randomized phase 3 trial, tebentafusp significantly prolonged overall survival in HLA-A*02:01-positive patients with **metastatic uveal melanoma**, representing the first systemic agent to demonstrate a survival benefit in this disease.

right.title: Cutaneous Melanoma

steps.tx: Surgical assessment of the regional lymphatic basin dictates staging and systemic management in primary melanoma. **Sentinel lymph node biopsy** is standard staging procedure for patients presenting with a primary cutaneous lesion exhibiting **Breslow thickness** of 0.8 mm or greater, or thinner lesions with ulceration. Identifying microscopic occult nodal involvement provides essential prognostic stratification and directs decisions regarding adjuvant immunotherapy.

Identifying occult nodal involvement provides essential prognostic stratification.
